parameters.query:
SELECT
    l.id AS lead_id,
    l.organization_id,
    l.first_name,
    l.last_name,
    l.email,
    l.status AS lead_status,
    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'channel', i.channel,
                'direction', i.direction,
                'type', i.interaction_type,
                'subject', i.subject,
                'transcript', i.transcript,
                'occurred_at', i.occurred_at
            )
            ORDER BY i.occurred_at
        ) FILTER (WHERE i.id IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS interactions
FROM leads l
INNER JOIN interactions i
    ON i.lead_id = l.id
    AND i.organization_id = l.organization_id
WHERE l.organization_id = 'e173a695-20b2-4f33-ba6b-9662911501da'
  AND l.status NOT IN ('lost', 'disqualified')
GROUP BY
    l.id,
    l.organization_id,
    l.first_name,
    l.last_name,
    l.email,
    l.status
ORDER BY MAX(i.occurred_at) DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH existing_task AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM agent_tasks
    WHERE organization_id = $1::uuid
      AND agent_name = 'WF-22-AI-Churn-Monitoring'
      AND input->>'lead_id' = $2::text
      AND status = 'pending'
      AND input->>'action_type' = 'RETENTION_ESCALATION'
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
inserted_task AS (
    INSERT INTO agent_tasks (
        organization_id,
        agent_name,
        status,
        correlation_id,
        input,
        output
    )
    SELECT
        $1::uuid,
        'WF-22-AI-Churn-Monitoring',
        'pending',
        $3::uuid,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'lead_id', $2::text,
            'action_type', 'RETENTION_ESCALATION',
            'priority', 'urgent',
            'churn_risk', $4::numeric,
            'risk_level', 'HIGH'
        ),
        $5::jsonb
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_task)
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT id, 'created' AS result FROM inserted_task
UNION ALL
SELECT id, 'already_exists' AS result FROM existing_task;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE customer_profiles
    SET
        churn_risk = $3::numeric,
        health_score = $4::numeric,
        attributes = COALESCE(attributes, '{}'::jsonb)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'risk_level', $5::text,
                'reason', $6::text,
                'recommended_action', $7::text,
                'last_churn_analysis', $8::text
            ),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE organization_id = $1::uuid
      AND lead_id = $2::uuid
    RETURNING id
),
inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO customer_profiles (
        organization_id,
        lead_id,
        churn_risk,
        health_score,
        attributes
    )
    SELECT
        $1::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        $3::numeric,
        $4::numeric,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'risk_level', $5::text,
            'reason', $6::text,
            'recommended_action', $7::text,
            'last_churn_analysis', $8::text
        )
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT id, 'updated' AS result FROM updated
UNION ALL
SELECT id, 'created' AS result FROM inserted;
